{{Quote|Welcome to Vaced, stranger. I'm Frutchoo. I represent the law around here, and these are my deputies.|Frutchoo introducing himself|<ref name="DASR" />}}
'''Frutchoo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] biker who collected a spaceport tax on the planet [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. He lead a group of bikers which he referred to as his "deputies", but one member of the group did not like being bossed around an preferred the word "associates". He worked at the [[Vaced Spaceport]], and welcomed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] and [[Breakout Squad]] to his planet. Kungurama used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince him that he did not want to collect their spaceport tax, and that him and his group were all very thirsty.<ref name="DASR" />
